meta.note: Target spec for the IM refactor: colours are today's values; type roles, radii and icon rules are the agreed end state.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card and list. Tailwind: bg-background.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, sheets, popovers, inputs. Tailwind: bg-card / bg-popover / bg-surface.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: tab rails, secondary buttons, hovered rows, skeletons, switch track. Tailwind aliases: bg-muted, bg-accent, bg-secondary, bg-surface-2.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px separators, card and input outlines. Tailwind: border-border, border-input.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and default icons on background, card and surface-2 (≥14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, decorative icons beside text, on background and card (5.0:1 light, 7.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The filled control: primary buttons, checked checkbox and switch, current page chip. Inverts to near-white in dark so it still reads as a shape.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (≥15:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus rings and tinted borders; never a fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Monochrome emphasis: links, avatar monograms, the `accent` tone, the `wait` status.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft monochrome tint under accent-ink: the `wait`/`default` badge, avatar fallback, selected menu item.

tokens.name: status-new
tokens.usage: Text of the `new` status — always paired with status-new-border, never filled.

tokens.name: status-new-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the `new` badge and the hollow `new` dot.

tokens.name: status-wait
tokens.usage: `wait` status text and dot — rides the monochrome accent on purpose.

tokens.name: status-wait-soft
tokens.usage: `wait` badge fill.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: `done` status text and dot: completed, paid, confirmed.

tokens.name: status-done-soft
tokens.usage: `done` badge fill.

tokens.name: status-dead
tokens.usage: `dead` status text and dot: lost, cancelled, expired. A filled grey, so it never looks like `new`.

tokens.name: status-dead-soft
tokens.usage: `dead` badge fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The `success` tone for icons and text that report a system outcome (saved, synced). Not a decoration.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: The `warning` tone: needs attention soon (expiring health declaration, open balance).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failures only. No passive state is red.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive button. Dark flips to ink: white on #f97066 is 2.6:1 (fails); #18181b is 6.6:1. Changed from today's white-in-both.

tokens.name: artist-1
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp — names a person, never a state. Calendar blocks, avatar rings, chart series.

tokens.name: artist-2
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 2.

tokens.name: artist-3
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 3.

tokens.name: artist-4
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 4.

tokens.name: artist-5
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 5.

tokens.name: artist-6
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 6.

tokens.name: artist-7
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 7.

tokens.name: artist-8
tokens.usage: Artist identity ramp, slot 8.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: IMDisplay. One per screen at most: dashboard hero figure, onboarding question.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: IMHeadline. The page title in the page head; drawer and full-screen sheet titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: IMTitle. Card headers, section titles, dialog and sheet titles.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: IMSubtitle. Sub-sections inside a card, row primary text (a customer's name).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: הלקוח ביקש לדחות את הסשן לשבוע הבא.
styles.usage: IMText body. Default running text, message bubbles, notes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: IMText body-sm. Descriptions under titles, row secondary text, table cells, form help.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: IMLabel. Form field labels and key/value keys. No uppercase, no tracking — Hebrew has no case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: IMCaption. Timestamps, footnotes, badge text, status labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: IMText micro. Counters on nav items, dense calendar chips. 12px on touch screens — the legible floor for Hebrew.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text inside a badge, label-to-control nudge.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a field's label, control and help text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in buttons, gap between adjacent buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between rows of controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones, row horizontal padding, card section gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop (≥1024px).

tokens.name: radius-inset
tokens.usage: Anything inside a control or card: menu items, tab triggers, calendar days, checkbox, chips inside a card. Tailwind: rounded-md.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the tab rail, pagination buttons. Tailwind: rounded-lg. (Today's ui/ uses 12px here — the refactor moves controls to 10.)

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, sheets, popovers, toasts. Tailwind: rounded-xl.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, switch, avatar, status dots. Tailwind: rounded-full.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, outline buttons, inputs, the active tab. Tailwind: shadow-xs / shadow-sm.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float: dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, toasts. Tailwind: shadow-md and up.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: IMIcon xs: inside badges and status chips.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: IMIcon sm: inline with body-sm text, menu items, input adornments, sm buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: IMIcon md (default): buttons, nav items, card header icons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: IMIcon lg: icon-only toolbar buttons, prominent status.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: IMIcon xl: empty states and hero badges only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button, compact select, tab trigger.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height on desktop; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Default control height on phones.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Full-width primary CTA in auth, onboarding and sheet footers.
